plugins.name: pr-code-review
plugins.description: Pull request review toolkit with multi-model code analysis and Azure DevOps reporting. It runs diverse read-only reviewers, consolidates and verifies their findings, and includes a standalone skill for publishing structured findings from any source to ADO pull requests.

plugins.name: claude-auto-repo-setup
plugins.description: On session start and working-directory change, wires up local-only Claude conveniences in the current git repo: a CLAUDE.md pointing at an existing AGENTS.md, and individual symlinks into .claude/ for each skill under .github/skills and each agent under .github/agents. Skips repo skills whose names would shadow a built-in Claude Code skill. Idempotent, and adds everything to the repo's local git excludes so nothing is committed.

plugins.name: azure-kusto
plugins.description: Azure Data Explorer and KQL guidance for querying logs, telemetry, time series, and ADX resources.

plugins.name: azure-pipelines
plugins.description: Azure Pipelines YAML guidance with schema-aware language server support for pipelines and templates.

plugins.name: run-simplify
plugins.description: Code-quality cleanup pass over a diff. Four parallel review agents look for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude issues, then the fixes are applied. Adapted from the Claude Code built-in `simplify` skill.

plugins.name: common-commands
plugins.description: Ready-to-run slash commands wrapping instructions repeated often enough to be worth keeping in one place.

plugins.name: human-message-style
plugins.description: Rules for drafting concise, natural chat messages, emails, announcements, PR comments, and short teammate-facing summaries.

plugins.name: writing-clearly-and-concisely
plugins.description: Makes long-form writing clearer, tighter, and less AI-sounding. Bundles Strunk's Elements of Style with a condensed field guide to the tells of AI-generated prose.

plugins.name: sembr
plugins.description: Reflow prose into Semantic Line Breaks (sembr.org), one thought per line, across Markdown, AsciiDoc, reStructuredText, LaTeX, and other markup while preserving rendered output.
